The Technology Review has published several articles on various topics. Here are the summaries of each article:

The articles cover a wide range of topics including AI, censorship, cloning, and quantum mechanics. The first article discusses the impact of the 'censorship-industrial complex' on internet policies in the US. The second article reports on scientists creating female clones of male mice using CRISPR technology. The third article highlights the 2026 list of Innovators Under 35 from MIT Technology Review, recognizing young people doing groundbreaking scientific work and building clever technical fixes for sticky problems. The fourth article discusses a new measure called spectral density of geometric response in many-body quantum systems. The fifth article introduces spin-coherent quantum designs which are related to finite spin-coherent tomography and discrete coherent-state operator bases.
